articles.title: Strategy sells 3,588 Bitcoin for $216M to fund dividends, keeps $2.55B reserve intact
articles.snippet: Strategy sold $216 million in Bitcoin to fund its dividend payments, as wealth manager Bernstein maintained its year-end Bitcoin price target of $150,000.

articles.title: AI Researchers Got Chatbots to Share Cocaine Recipes Using This One Wild Trick
articles.snippet: Researchers say a new jailbreak technique tricked AI models into treating attacker-written text as their own reasoning, bypassing safety guardrails and exposing a deeper security flaw.

articles.title: Metaplanet Adds 2,823 Bitcoin in Q2 as Buying Pace Cools
articles.snippet: The Japanese firm's 43,000-BTC stack now sits well below its cost basis, and it has leaned on debt over equity to keep buying.
